metadata.title: About me — Mathias, founder of SellifyWorks
metadata.description: I'm Mathias, a software engineer. I founded SellifyWorks in late 2024 to work with growing Shopify stores. You talk to me, not to a sales rep.

hero.subtitle: Software engineer, Argentinian living in Barcelona. I founded SellifyWorks in late 2024.

journey.photoAlt: Mathias Do Vale, founder of SellifyWorks
journey.name: Mathias Do Vale
journey.body: I chose computing because of that idea. Behind SellifyWorks there is no sales rep handing your store to a team you have never met: you talk to the person who designs and builds your project, end to end.

card.eyebrow: What I learned in all those teams
card.text: The best work comes out of a team. With you, too.

items.title: I started with data
items.description: Reports, models and dashboards so other people could make better decisions.

items.title: Computer Engineer
items.description: I graduated from UADE, in Argentina.

items.title: I moved into development
items.description: A digital wallet, clients in the United States and a public-sector project built for citizens.

items.title: I founded SellifyWorks
items.description: From Barcelona, to bring all of that to growing Shopify stores.

cta.title: Does your store fit this profile?
cta.subtitle: If you're below the radar of the big agencies, let's talk.
